responsibility: This file implements the token buffering, source-location tracking, and comment association layer between the flex lexer and the mc parser passes. It owns the token record and bucket structures, stores token kind/string/integer/comment plus line, column, and source-include stack metadata, supports replay across multiple passes, token insertion and rewind for recovery, file push/pop tracking across includes, and lookup of line, column, and filename from token numbers, making it the reusable lexical token stream database consumed by mcp1-mcp5 and the diagnostics subsystem.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the concrete implementation behind GmcLexBuf.h: it defines the token/source-list storage structures, owns the current-token globals, and implements buffering, replay, insertion, and token-to-file/line/column mapping logic.
